Stage 3 · Grammar

Grammar

this · that · these · those
WordOne / ManyExample
thisone (near)This is a book.
thatone (far)That's a pen.
thesemany (near)These are books.
thosemany (far)Those are pens.
  • Near you → this (one) / these (many).
  • Far from you → that (one) / those (many).
  • One → this/that + a: this is a book. Many → these/those + plural: these are books.
  • Ask: What's this? — It's a pen. What are these? — They're keys.

→ Present Simple (I work / she works) comes later.

🔧 Build it yourself
  • 🔧 Build it yourself
  • Build it: near + one → THIS; far + one → THAT; near + many → THESE; far + many → THOSE.
  • ⚠ Этот/тот · бұл/анау — same idea: first ask near or far? then one or many?

Stage 6 · Speaking

Your turn

Write two short lines: point at things (this / these) and add a colour.

When you finish, open the model answer and check yourself.

Model answer

This is my bag. It's black and small. These are my books. They're new.

Check yourself:

  • Did you use this / that / these / those?
  • Did you add a colour (red, blue…)?
  • Is it is (one) or are (many)?
Talk to Sam. Answer with the words from this lesson.

Read each message. Tap 🔊 to hear Sam.

Sam

Hi again! I'm Sam. 👋

Sam

What's this? 📱

Sam

Yes! 📱

Sam

What are these? 🔑🔑

Sam

Great! 🔑

Sam

Listen: “These is my books.” 🤔

Why

these / those (many) → are: These are my books. this / that (one) → is.

Sam

Yes! “These are my books.” Great catch. 🌟

Feedback

Well done: you named things with this / these and fixed is / are. Next time, say it out loud too.
